prompts.prompt: In 1Password Secrets Automation, what prefix do service account tokens start with? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/1password-secrets/SKILL.md - service account token starts with ops_ (e.g. OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN=ops_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx)

prompts.prompt: What annotation do you add to a Kubernetes deployment so the 1Password Kubernetes operator automatically restarts the deployment when the referenced secret changes? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/1password-secrets/SKILL.md - annotation operator.1password.io/auto-restart: true triggers auto-restart on secret change

prompts.prompt: In a Docker Compose deployment of 1Password Connect Server, what are the names of the two service images that make up the deployment? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/1password-secrets/SKILL.md - docker-compose.yml defines connect-api and connect-sync services
